name: Moon Priestess Amara
summary: West of Dolanaar, Moon Priestess Amara keeps watch over the road to Darnassus. Two huntresses stand guard beside her as she watches Teldrassil’s woodland paths.

sections.title: Guardian of the Boughways
sections.body: Moon Priestess Amara watches the road west of Dolanaar with Nhemai and Yaeliura, two huntress companions. As a priestess of the Sisterhood of Elune, she offers spiritual guidance while helping keep Teldrassil’s roads secure. Travelers bound for Darnassus can seek directions from her. Those burdened in spirit can also ask her for a path to redemption.

faq.answer: Moon Priestess Amara, also known as Amara Nightwalker, serves the Sisterhood of Elune. She watches the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus in Teldrassil and cares for travelers’ safety and spiritual well-being.

faq.q: Where can I find Moon Priestess Amara?
faq.answer: You can find Moon Priestess Amara along the paved road just west of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Two sentinel huntresses stand at her side.

faq.q: Who are the huntresses standing with her?
faq.answer: Huntress Nhemai and Huntress Yaeliura accompany and guard Amara. The two night elf sentinels help protect the road from beasts and hostile corruption.

angles.text: As a priest of the Sisterhood of Elune, you share Priestess Amara’s devotion to the Moon Goddess. She guides young acolytes setting out from Shadowglen.
As a night elf, you meet Amara on your journey west from Dolanaar. Her guidance and tasks lead you toward Darnassus.
